description: NaNiF₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.53 Å. Ni²⁺ is bonded to six F¹⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and four longer (2.02 Å) Ni-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ni²⁺ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₂Ni₂ tetrahedra. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ni²⁺ atoms.
